why: run-metadata.json for this run records simulation.gitSha as "unknown" and simulation.gitDirty as true. Both are wrong. This file corrects the record additively; run-metadata.json is left exactly as the run wrote it, because editing a completed run's own record to say something it did not say would falsify it.
basis: the run id embeds the short sha f76d110
the injector's /opt/avni-perf/.harness-sha held the full sha, written when the tarball was unpacked
the tarball was produced by `git archive` from a tree verified clean with `git status --porcelain` immediately before publishing
cause: avni-infra's roles/avni_injector delivers the harness as a `git archive` tarball, deliberately, so that a disposable host never holds a deploy key for a private repo. `git archive` strips .git, so archiveRun's `git rev-parse HEAD` failed and its gitOutput helper returned the string "unknown". The dirty check is `!gitOutput('git','status','--porcelain').isEmpty()`, which read that non-empty "unknown" as uncommitted changes -- a false positive on top of a missing value.
fixedBy: avni-perf fb6c06b -- archiveRun honours -DSIMULATION_SHA, and only consults git for dirtiness when git is present
appliesFrom: runs after 2026-10-05T09:00Z record this correctly without a correction file
